pairs.difference: A: light from upper left; the barrel side falls into a mid orange, and the wheel face turns evenly darker toward lower right. In the lens the whole body sits fairly low, so one side reads as shadow. Highlights are thin edge lines on the bevels. B: the body stays pale and evenly lit in the lens, and the only deep darks are the window and mouth cavities, which jump to saturated red. A pale halo wraps the silhouette and lifts the background, and there is little true shadow side on the body. The evidence is weak because both are clean plastic forms.
pairs.fix: Light the whistle from the upper left only. Let the right side of the round chamber fall into a clear darker orange shadow, keep the inside of the window a dull dark orange rather than glowing red, and remove the pale glow around the whistle.

pairs.difference: A: the bell has a broken metallic sheen with dark reflected bands inside the flare, the tube loop turns quickly into cool grey shadow, and the rope has tight small shadows between thin turns. B: the rope knot and tassels are fat, inflated lobes with soft pillow shading and a broad sheen on each lobe. The tube has one smooth gradient, the light comes from the front, and the background glows brightly behind the bell.
pairs.fix: Draw thin hard brass with sharp narrow reflections and dark bands along the tube. Make the cord thin and tightly wound with small dark gaps between turns, and make the tassels fine strands rather than puffy rubber lobes. Remove the glow behind the bugle.

pairs.difference: A: the light is frontal and even. The cup, the raised flower and the thick blue rims are all puffy, each with its own soft sheen, so the lens shows the flower as an inflated bump with a soft glow. The shadow side of the cup barely drops, and the cast shadow is a diffuse blob under the saucer. B: there is one clear side light. The lens shows a lit left-centre body turning gently into a darker right and lower edge, with crisp specular on the thin porcelain rim, a dark contact line under the foot, and a defined cast shadow running left across the surface.
pairs.fix: Use one soft light from the right. Make the cup thin porcelain with a narrow sharp highlight on the rim, paint the flower flat on the surface with no raised shading, and put a thin dark contact shadow under the cup foot and a clear cast shadow across the table.

pairs.difference: A: the apples turn softly from a lit upper left into deep red on the lower right, with small restrained highlights. The cloth has low relief, the weave sits in shadow toward the right, and the soft cast shadow to the right is short and sits close under the basket. B: each apple has a similar glossy white sheen and each leaf has its own lit gradient. The weave strips are pillowy and individually rimmed, and the lens shows even repeated lighting with no overall shadow side on the basket. A long dark shadow sits on the left while the top of the basket stays fully lit, and a glow sits behind the handle.
pairs.fix: Light the whole basket as one form, with the right side falling into shadow across all the strips. Keep apple highlights small and soft, reduce the plastic shine, and make the cast shadow short and close to the base, with no glow behind the handle.

pairs.difference: A: the staves are flat, evenly lit faces in the lens, with little turn across the barrel; only the outer staves drop. The hoops carry repeated round rivets, each with its own identical highlight, and the rim blocks are chunky, each with a separate soft bevel. The cast shadow to the right is a clean hard-edged shape. B: there is a clear cylinder turn, a bright band left of centre falling off to dark on both flanks. The hoops have narrow, streaked metal sheen, and a soft dark contact shadow sits at the base.
pairs.fix: Shade the barrel as one round cylinder, with a bright vertical band near the centre fading into dark staves on both sides. Give the metal hoops a narrow streaky shine, and put a soft dark contact shadow around the base. Do not give every stave and rivet its own bevel highlight.

pairs.difference: A: the broad bonnet and roof take soft light, the side panels fall gently, and the windows go uniformly dark in the lens. The chrome is restrained and grey, and a soft dark shadow lies under the body, reaching toward the viewer. B: every part is swollen and has its own highlight, with white sheens on the bumper guards, mirror, headlight rims, wheel hubs and fenders. Light comes from the front, so the front face is not in shadow, and a purple-tinted bounce sits on the road under the car with only a thin dark contact.
pairs.fix: Use one broad soft light from above and behind one shoulder, with a large calm sheen on the bonnet and roof. Dull the chrome to soft grey with few highlights, darken the windows evenly, and put one solid dark shadow under the car.

pairs.difference: A: the tent is two simple planes, a sunlit bright front and a greyer left slope in the lens, with soft turns along the fabric folds and a black opening. It sits in soft ambient shade on the grass. B: the light is theatrical, with light shafts from the upper right and warm orange glow in the tent folds, the lantern emitting its own glow. Each peg, strap and rope has its own lit edge, and the bedding inside is lit almost as bright as the outside instead of falling into shadow.
pairs.fix: Light the tent from one side so one slope is clearly in shadow, and leave the opening dark with nothing lit inside. Remove the sun rays and lantern glow, and give the tent a soft shadow on the grass.

pairs.difference: A: the pot takes a matte grey top light, darkening into a scorched lower body, with a strong red glow pooled only at the base directly above the flame. The lit side is simple and the shadow side is deep in the lens. B: the pot is a smooth glossy ball with a broad sheen, orange rim bounce around the underside, and an orange glow spreading on all the stones. Each stone, log end and stump is a pillowy form with its own lit top, so the scene is evenly bright with no deep shadow side.
pairs.fix: Make the pot matte iron with no glossy sheen, dark and sooty toward the bottom, with the fire glow only in a small patch right above the flames. Let the logs and stones keep plain soft top light with dark undersides.

pattern: Generated cards still model each part separately instead of lighting the object as one form: every lobe, rivet, strap and stone gets its own soft bevel and sheen. Light is frontal or even, so there is no shared shadow side, and shadow sides stay shallow. Forms read inflated and pillowy with repeated glossy highlights, and there are extra glows: halos behind the hero, light rays, emissive bounce. Real cards commit to one direction, with narrower speculars, darker flanks and tight contact shadows.
